config:
# Provider registrations for the community data services Lodestar's census covers. Kittiwake read these
# with one getLogs from block 0, which only Alchemy would serve. Only the two events the census uses are
# in the ABI. Each start block is the contract's first log of any kind.
[nest]
name = "data-services-nest"
chain = "arbitrum-one"
chain_id = 42161
rpc_urls = [
    "https://arb1.arbitrum.io/rpc",
    "https://arbitrum-one-rpc.publicnode.com",
]
schema_version = 1
block_timestamps = true

[[contracts]]
alias = "dispatch"
address = "0x7101d5c1a5c89c3647f5118da118e56c023ba0b9"
start_block = 456917519
abi = "abis/data_service.json"
